ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: F*app needs your location to show you people nearby and, during a meetup, to share it with your trusted contact.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: During a meetup, F*app shares your location with your trusted contact, even when your screen is off. Outside of meetups, it doesn't use your location in the background.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: F*app uses Face ID to unlock, so no one else can look inside.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Take a photo of yourself for your profile.
